thesis: The speakers argue that the next 25 years of Silicon Valley innovation will be defined by a return to investing in defense, aerospace, and technologies that support the national interest, a shift triggered by the 2022 invasion of Ukraine. They contend that while the region previously swung toward software and away from hardware and patriotic engineering, the current era is characterized by a synergy between software and hardware as firms like Andreessen Horowitz dedicate capital to these categories.
